directive.quote: Every engine job of the old Worker's rust-engine backlog rows works on the new engine, one to one or better.

preserve: OPTIONS answers dav 1, allow OPTIONS, PROPFIND, GET, HEAD and ms-author-via DAV
the key is a Basic password under any user name or a Bearer token, trimmed; without one, 401 with Basic realm "Your files"
a name that is neither a folder nor stored is 404; GET or HEAD of a folder is 405 allow OPTIONS, PROPFIND; every other method is 405
PROPFIND lists the entry, and unless Depth is 0 its child folders and stored names, at most list_limit 5000

davResponse: href per segment as encodeURIComponent below the prefix, a folder's href ends in /, displayname, collection resourcetype or getcontentlength, getetag the identity and getlastmodified as an HTTP date when known; the multistatus body in the same words
a file is read by ranges from wherever it is kept, through read_range
allowed_deltas: deciding whose key or lease it is stays with the door (userFromKey, wholeNamespaceReader); dav.rs answers one signed-in request
one answer carries at most READ_MAX_BYTES of a file; a larger whole-file GET is answered 416 with accept-ranges so the client reads by ranges, where the Worker streamed the whole object
an upload in progress is not listed (the Rust account files list stored names; uploads are not names until finished)

the folder is the door's /dav route (capabilities.json door row; its path is DATA, src/mcp/carried/settings.json dav_path): the door admits the key by its own bearer check and answers through the account files door's `dav` operation, which no tool run is granted
banned_substitutions: a name of another person listed
a whole object read from a store when a range was asked
